scope: Read-only accepted-only phase progress from administrator-enrolled external confirmations, scoped contract/input invalidation, operator API and panel.
counts_note: Server assertions are inside one Node runner unit and are not added again. Earlier 11/12 round overlaps with the final suite.

initial_failure.reason: Actual manifest uses implemented_pending_acceptance; parser now recognizes it and displays pending acceptance.

checks: Manifest accepted/test-pass declarations alone yield no accepted progress
Partial receipts count only prerequisite-satisfied accepted tasks; stage needs every task
Missing independent role/OP or declared implementer self-confirmation refuses acceptance
Changed task contracts invalidate affected gates and dependent stages; unrelated gates remain valid
Registered code and authority inputs invalidate original receipts; routine status evidence does not
Changed receipt bytes and later pending decisions never fall back to old passed records
Current blockers prevent accepted counts and show release/responsibility/review details
Project filters avoid opening unrelated project files; public response excludes configured paths
Malformed partitions, dependency cycles, statuses and oversized files reject
Real 72-task manifest and old unsigned G01 draft remain at zero accepted
CLI generates only pending digest-bound drafts without writing
Actual HTTP rejects missing/worker/review tokens and foreign origin

trust_boundary: Administrator must verify external review sources before enrolling receipt byte hashes. Display names and references are records, not cryptographic signatures.
Registered code/config/evidence input scope must be complete and independently reviewed. Changes outside declared inputs cannot be detected.
Administrator files must be protected from executor writes by deployment permissions; this batch does not establish Windows ACL isolation.
Local projection does not automatically distribute confirmation files across computers.
